note: Every dynamic import, and what reads its module in before a person can reach it (scripts/rules-lint.mjs). Nothing is imported on a user tap.

imports.src/ui/host.js → ../worker-core.js: only when a Worker cannot start (the engine runs on the page instead), at boot
imports.src/ui/calc-client.js → ../worker-core.j: the same fallback for a presentation's own engine, when its Worker cannot start
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./presenter-view-page.j: only the presenter's second window (?presenter-view), whose page loads it at boot instead of the app; no person reaches it from a tap
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./doppler.js: main.js warmUp, idle after boot and under the loading cover
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./fibroscan.js: main.js warmUp, idle after boot and under the loading cover
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./trials-pane.js: main.js warmUp (dock.load asks every lazy pane), idle after boot and under the loading cover; a Tests tab left open at the last visit is read in at boot
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./from-readings.js: main.js warmUp, idle after boot and under the loading cover; the patient menu's From readings row reads it in on a tap, the module is there by then
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./presenter.js: main.js warmUp, idle after boot and under the loading cover
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./palette.js: main.js warmUp, idle after boot and under the loading cover
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./lap.js: ?lap only, at boot (the device lap, a measuring aid)
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./watch/start.js: ?watch only, on the preview copy or a local run, at boot (the motion recorder and its red dot)
imports.src/ui/presenter.js → ./test-decks/demo-: the preview copy only, when the presenter module is read in
imports.src/ui/presenter.js → ./gallery/deck.js: the preview copy only, with the Testing deck above (the gallery deck: every card kind, one slide each)
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./screen/index.js: only when pps.screen() is called (a console, the bug packet, a test): the screen report, text and JSON; no person reaches it from a tap and nothing at boot reads it
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./gallery/page.js: ?gallery on the preview copy only (the card gallery and debug page), at boot; no person reaches it from a tap and the live site never reads it
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./packet/feedback.js: read in when Send feedback is tapped and held no longer than FEEDBACK_READ_MS, so the mail draft never waits on it: a diagnostic read of the screen for the report, not a part of any screen a person is looking at
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./packet/trigger.js: the preview copy and a local run only (the bug packet: the Alt+Shift+/ chord, a long press on the preview pill, pps.packet, a state link's extras), at boot; no person reaches it from a tap and the live site never reads it
?gallery=frame on the preview copy only (the device frame's outer page, which does not start the app), at boot
imports.src/ui/gallery/page.js → ../decks.js: a tap on a specimen's Tools list (the real slides that use it); the presenter has read the decks in long before
stage-lobload.js lobuleCode, once the figure is shown (prepIdle), long before the lobule can be opened
imports.src/ui/stage.js → ./organ-art-lite.js: at boot only, when storage still holds Lighter organ art on (pps.fig.lightArt); its Settings row is gone, so no tap reaches it
imports.src/ui/text-gl.js → ./glyph-data.js: gl-words.js and label-gl.js call loadGlyphs at boot
imports.src/ui/text-gl.js → ./glyph-data-opsz.js: loadGlyphs fetches it with glyph-data.js (gl-words.js and label-gl.js call loadGlyphs at boot)
imports.src/ui/text-gl.js → ./glyph-metrics.js: NOT YET: loadMetrics fetches it where a paragraph is laid out, and no app code calls loadMetrics yet (only the tests); whoever wires layoutParagraph in must call it at boot or idle, never on a tap
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./cam-gate.js: the console's camera gate only (pps.cameraGate, a measuring aid typed in the console); no tap reaches it
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./decks.js: the console's camera gate only (pps.cameraGate), and the presenter has read the decks in long before (main.js warmUp)
imports.src/ui/main.js → ./test-mode.js: pps.testClock, the camera gate and ?testclock only (play-tests, a console call; no person reaches it from a tap)
